note: Re-judged 2026-11-20 by an independent agent after 3977cef525 changed TestChildSAReplayWindowDefault. RFC 4303 Section 3.4.3: "A minimum window size of 32 packets MUST be supported when 32-bit sequence numbers are employed; a window size of 64 is preferred and SHOULD be employed as the default." The test now drives createFirstChildSA over a mock dataplane, requires two SAs in the order inbound then outbound by their Dir, asserts ReplayWin == 64 on the inbound state and 0 on the outbound one, which Linux refuses a window on. A window below 32 on the receiving state goes red, and the earlier note's both-SAs claim is replaced by the receiver-only reading RFC 4301 Section 4.4.2.1 gives the window. installChildDataplane sets ReplayWin from replayWindow on the inbound SAParams only, and xfrmStateFromParams projects it, as the single-polarity annotation states. Ze negotiates no ESN, so every SA uses 32-bit sequence numbers. The VPP backend cannot carry a window size (ipsec_sad_entry_v3; vppSAFlags turns anti-replay on and VPP applies its own window), so this verdict covers the XFRM default path.
